patch.value: Some stones want a blow: [[key|attack]] on them.
有些石头要挨一下：对它们按[[key|attack]]。
Some stones want a blow: [[key|attack]] on them.

why: An `attack-block` teaching line added, with its zh-cn row. No walked path of the gallery strikes a block — the hearth stone's `strike` is a trigger no path performs — so the line would be shown to nobody: an inert declaration, refused with shape B.
